name: Cloaca: One Hole One Whole Rave
description: The debut edition of Cloaca, a new queer rave series launching in Berlin. This underground club night features DJs Smoko, Formosa, and others, offering a space for queer expression through driving electronic music. The event starts at 10PM with a $30 entry fee, bringing together the community for a night of dancing and celebration in Berlin's vibrant nightlife scene.
